cover_headline: A2B Sells Majority Stake to James Murdoch-Backed Bodhi Tree in $180 Million Deal
facts: A2B has sold a majority stake to Bodhi Tree Systems for $180 million, in a transaction valuing the company at approximately $350 million
Uday Shankar, co-founder of Bodhi Tree with James Murdoch, will serve as chairperson of A2B's new board
A2B runs about 160 outlets in India and more than 30 overseas, and reported revenue of about Rs 1,487 crore for the year ended March 2025

end.headline: A2B Sells Majority Stake to James Murdoch-Backed Bodhi Tree in $180 Million Deal
end.line: The Chennai vegetarian chain, valued at about $350 million, will use the investment to expand in western India and Europe and modernise its kitchens.
